skill.name: code-refactoring
skill.description: Simplify and refactor code while preserving behavior, improving clarity, and reducing complexity. Use it to remove duplication, extract methods, apply SOLID principles, and validate behavior after each change.
skill.summary: Guide behavior-preserving code refactors with examples, checklists, and validation steps.
skill.author: supercent-io

content.value_statement: Complex code slows changes and raises regression risk. This skill guides behavior-preserving refactors with tests, extraction patterns, and validation steps.
actual_capabilities: Guides Extract Method refactors for long functions.
Shows how to remove duplicated database query logic.
Suggests polymorphism for long conditional payment flows.
Groups long parameter lists into typed objects.
Defines behavior validation checklists and test commands.
Documents preserved behavior, risks, and test status.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples; it does not execute refactors automatically.
It assumes tests or validation steps are available.
Examples focus on TypeScript-style code and may need translation.
It cannot prove behavior preservation without running project tests.

use_cases.title: Simplify Legacy Functions
use_cases.description: Break long functions into named methods while keeping inputs, outputs, and side effects unchanged.

use_cases.title: Prepare Code Before Feature Work
use_cases.description: Reduce duplication and clarify boundaries before adding new behavior to an existing module.

use_cases.title: Review Refactoring Plans
use_cases.description: Check that planned refactors include tests, behavior validation, risk notes, and follow-up work.

prompt_templates.title: Find Safe Refactors
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one function or class.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the selected code. Identify duplication, long methods, and simple Extract Method opportunities. Keep behavior unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Refactoring Checklist
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a small refactor before editing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a checklist for refactoring this module. Include tests to run, behavior to preserve, and risks to watch.

prompt_templates.title: Plan A Behavior-Preserving Refactor
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this code and propose a step-by-step refactoring plan. Separate responsibilities, remove duplication, and define validation after each step.

prompt_templates.title: Design A Multi-Step Refactoring Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an incremental refactoring strategy for this subsystem. Include dependency boundaries, test coverage gaps, rollback points, and review checkpoints.

output_examples.input: A long order-processing function mixes validation, pricing, inventory checks, and persistence.
output: Extract validation, total calculation, inventory checking, and order creation.
Run unit tests and compare error handling before and after the change.

output_examples.input: Two user query functions repeat active-user filters and selected fields.
output: Create one shared query helper with an optional filter.
Add tests for default and filtered query behavior.

output_examples.input: A payment processor uses a long conditional for several payment methods.
output: Define a common payment method interface.
Move each payment method into its own implementation.
Validate unsupported payment handling and existing payment results.

best_practices: Write or identify tests before changing structure.
Refactor in small steps and validate after each step.
Document behavior preserved, risks, and follow-up work.
anti_patterns: Extracting abstractions before understanding existing behavior.
Skipping tests because changes look mechanical.

faq.question: Does this skill change application behavior?
faq.answer: No. It emphasizes preserving behavior while improving code structure and clarity.

faq.question: Which languages does it fit best?
faq.answer: The examples use TypeScript, but the refactoring principles apply to many languages.

faq.question: Can it replace automated tests?
faq.answer: No. It recommends tests and validation, but project tests must still be run.

faq.question: Does it execute commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. Command examples are documentation for validation steps such as tests, type checks, and linting.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it before feature work, after bug fixes, during code review, or while reducing technical debt.

faq.question: How should I review the output?
faq.answer: Check that behavior stays the same, tests pass, and each change has a clear reason.
